won a $150M ceiling IDIQ contract for a new survivability test stand for the U.S. Air Force’s 704th Test Group.
The contract covers the design, procurement, and installation of the new test facility at Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico.
The work is expected to be completed by September 2031.
A total of $2.43M in fiscal 2026 research, development, test, and evaluation funds were obligated at the time of award.
The Air Force Test Center is the contracting activity.

title: Amentum Technology wins $150M U.S. Air Force IDIQ contract
